regions.merged_text: Thanks be to God for uncountable mercies - for all things. Thanks to my neighbor for his charitable patience : fifty years of Capuchin life have almost unnoticed slipped ahead of me into eternity - whither I hope to follow before half of another fifty. Deo Gratias. The Lord be praised in all His designs!

regions.merged_text: Thanks be to God for uncount- able mercies - for every blessing: Thanks to my neighbor for his charitable patience; my first fifty years in the Order - almost unnoticed - has slipped away from me into eternal life. Thither I hope to follow before half another fifty - trusting in the merciful goodness of God.

regions.merged_text: What shall I render to the Lord for all He hath done for me? He created me to know Him .. that includes all the rest - God made me to know Him. O what a blessed Him! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun - For the grateful on earth - To treasure aright !!! - Highest Heaven its worth. He permits me To-day to Start a second fifty years in the Order. "Quid retrbuam!" Now shall thank Him! May the rest of my Existence be an Eternal Deo Gratias-to God and my Neighbor! - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
